title: Cash-poor Gamma sells Illinois only for liquidity
description: Cash-poor Gamma sells Illinois only for liquidity. The cash-poor counterparty makes a utility-plus-cash structure plausible. The offer has to be credible to the counterparty while preserving Alpha's actual strategic edge.

final_action.public_message: Hey Gamma, I'd love to complete my red set. I'll give you $300 for Illinois Avenue. Let me know if that works for you!
final_action.private_thought: Acquiring Illinois completes my red monopoly (Kentucky, Indiana, Illinois). This will allow me to build houses and increase rent dramatically. Offering $300 seems fair given my cash reserve and his cash advantage.
